rationale: The short thesis required sustained price action below the 5-min VWAP ($43.90), but the last several candles show a clear upward drift — price has recovered from the $43.31 MFE low all the way back to $43.83, with the most recent higher-volume candle (20K shares) closing near its high at $43.80, indicating absorption rather than continued distribution.
